content_sections.heading: ANGRAU Research Associate (RA) Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ANGRAU Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download ANGRAU Research Associate (RA) Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Research Associate (RA): Doctoral Degree/Ph.D. in Remote Sensing & Geographical Information System OR Master's degree in Remote Sensing & Geographical Information with 4 years Bachelor's Degree having first division or 60% marks with at least 03 years of research experience.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Research Associate (RA): Maximum age not exceeding 40 years for men and 45 years for women. Age Relaxations: SC, ST, and BC categories as per Government norms, and women up to 45 years.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Research Associate (M.Tech): Rs.61,000/- + HRA per month Research Associate (Ph.D.): Rs.67,000/- + HRA per month

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ANGRAU Research Associate (RA) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University (ANGRAU) located in Guntur, Andhra Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in ANGRAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available post is Research Associate (RA) under temporary field research operations.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Research Associate position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for ANGRAU Research Associate posts?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to directly attend the walk-in interview on the scheduled date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the date for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 15 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are required for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Doctoral Degree/Ph.D. or Master's degree in Remote Sensing & Geographical Information / RS & GIS with a 4-year Bachelor's degree and relevant experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the upper age limit for male and female candidates?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is not exceeding 40 years for men and 45 years for women, with relaxations applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary offered for Research Associate positions?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 61,000/- plus HRA per month for M.Tech (RS&GIS) holders and Rs. 67,000/- plus HRA per month for Ph.D. holders.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the location of the job and interview venue?
faq.answer: The job location and interview venue are based in Guntur, Andhra Pradesh (Pincode: 522034).

faq.question: Q10. Do candidates need to pay any application fee?
faq.answer: No application fee is required or mentioned in the official notification for attending this walk-in interview.
